title: Rogue Mecha Cop
kicker: Mecha Cop wants to subdue you
subtitle: Stop and frisk
body: You hear sirens suddenly explode to life and see a strange police officer jump out from behind a building. "UNAUTHORIZED TRAINER. PREPARE TO BE SUBDUED."
resultTitle: One less cop terrorizing the streets.

title: Berry Tree
subtitle: Someone's loss is your gain.
body: A hollow beneath a mossy rock hides a small stash of berries, forgotten by whoever left them. They still look fresh.

title: Message in a Bottle
subtitle: The tide brought a gift.
body: A weathered bottle bobs against the rocks. Inside, wrapped in oilcloth, is a tidy roll of coins and a note that just reads "good luck."

title: Wandering Trader
subtitle: A trader spreads out their wares.
body: A cloaked trader flags you down. "Swap one of your Pokemon, or I'll teach a technique to anyone with the coin."

choices.title: Trade a Pokemon
choices.description: Hand over a random Pokemon for one of the trader's.

choices.title: Buy a technique
choices.description: Pay for a random attack card.

title: Volcanic Vent
subtitle: Heat shimmers off the rock.
body: A crack in the ground breathes hot air, and something glints deep inside. Reaching in could cost you — or pay off.

choices.title: Reach into the vent
choices.description: Scorch a random attack card, but grab a new one from the depths.

title: Team Rocket Ambush
subtitle: The boss himself blocks the path.
body: Grunts fan out across the trail, and Giovanni steps forward. "Hand over your team, or take your beating."
battleText: Beat Giovanni and the spoils are yours.
